description: One function that sends the same prompt to Anthropic, OpenAI, or a local Open WebUI server, branching on the selected provider.

steps.description: `callTextModel` takes the provider config, the prompt, and an options object with defaults for `maxTokens` and `temperature`. It reads `providerConfig.provider` into a local `provider`.

Three branches, one per provider. The comments mark each endpoint: Anthropic posts to `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`, OpenAI to `api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`, and Open WebUI to `<baseUrl>/api/chat/completions`.

If no branch matched, throw an error for an unsupported provider. The page says the rest of the app never knows or cares which provider is active, so adding a fourth provider means adding one more branch here and nothing else changes.

title: The callTextModel Dispatcher
